channel.title: The Celebrity Apprentice
channel.desc: Ho Ho Ho, Lord Sugar has a festive treat in store as 12 famous faces dash through the snow all the way to Lapland to create Christmas biscuits, jingles and adverts. From soap stars to stand-up comics and TVs favourite judge, these newly appointed elves work their Christmas socks off to raise some sweet dough in aid of Children in Need.
